name: Run a review on PR #482, watch it live, accept its finding and open its trace
description: The main journey end to end, with no model key: the hermetic API runs with DEVDIGEST_FAKE_LLM=1, whose fake LLM answers every review with one WARNING on the first added line of the diff (server/src/adapters/llm/fake.ts). Run all enabled agents from the Agent runs tab, see the live review (SSE), wait for the fake finding in the newest run (open by default, its first card expanded), accept it, then open the first Timeline run's trace. A 1280×1600 viewport keeps every target on screen: agent-browser 0.27 does not scroll the shell's inner pane before a click. Writes to the DB (new runs + an accepted finding) — the hermetic stack's Postgres is fresh each run.
